task_prompt: Go to zalando.com and search for Adidas sneakers. Open the first product and tell me its price.
verdict_reason: The agent successfully navigated to Zalando, searched for Adidas sneakers, opened the first product, and reported its price accurately.

step_assessments.reason: Initial navigation to the target website is essential to start the task.
Scrolling was necessary to locate the search bar or any relevant search option.
Clicking to accept cookies was necessary to proceed with further interactions on the site.
Clicking the link to access the search bar was necessary to input the search query.
Inputting the search query and initiating the search was essential to find the product.
Scrolling was not necessary as it did not contribute to resolving the loading issue.
Selecting the suggestion ensured the search was executed correctly.
Clicking the first product was necessary to view its details and find the price.
Reporting the price was the final goal of the task.

weaknesses: Initial navigation led to the French version of the site, which could confuse the agent.
The agent had to scroll and click multiple times to handle the cookie consent and locate the search bar.
key_findings: The agent was able to navigate and interact with a non-English version of the site.
Successfully handled a cookie consent popup that blocked interaction.
Accurately retrieved and reported the price of the first product.
